findings: GetTaskParams is #[non_exhaustive] with fields meta: Option<RequestMetaObject> and task_id: String; GetTaskParams::new(task_id) sets meta=None and task_id from Into<String>.
CancelTaskParams is #[non_exhaustive] with the same meta/task_id shape; CancelTaskParams::new(task_id) sets meta=None and task_id from Into<String>.
DetailedTask is a concrete struct { task: Task, payload: TaskPayload } in this release, and DetailedTask::new(task, payload) forces task.status to payload.status().

There is no impl From<Task> for DetailedTask in the exact fetched task.rs; constructing a GetTaskResult from a bare Task therefore requires choosing an explicit TaskPayload before GetTaskResult::new(DetailedTask::new(...)).

The exact fetched model.rs and task.rs contain no GetTaskPayloadParams symbol; absence is scoped only to these two exact release files, not generalized to the entire repository without further search.
